scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm boundaries && pnpm packages:check && pnpm deadcode && pnpm build
scripts.fallow:web:audit: corepack pnpm dlx fallow --root . --workspace apps/web audit
scripts.fallow:web:dead-code: corepack pnpm dlx fallow --root . --workspace apps/web --only dead-code
scripts.fallow:web:dupes: corepack pnpm dlx fallow --root . --workspace apps/web --only dupes --dupes-mode mild
scripts.fallow:web:health: corepack pnpm dlx fallow --root . --workspace apps/web --only health
scripts.jscpd:web: corepack pnpm dlx jscpd apps/web/src --min-lines 8 --min-tokens 50 --reporters console --mode mild
scripts.packages:check: node scripts/check-package-boundaries.mjs && pnpm deadcode:packages && pnpm packages:duplication
scripts.packages:duplication: corepack pnpm dlx jscpd packages --min-lines 8 --min-tokens 50 --reporters console --mode mild --threshold 3 --ignore '**/schema.ts,**/openapi.json,**/dist/**'
scripts.packages:duplication:generated: corepack pnpm dlx jscpd packages/orchestrator-contracts packages/display-sidecar-contracts --min-lines 8 --min-tokens 50 --reporters console --mode mild --ignore '**/index.ts'
